verdict.summary: This baby swing with mosquito net (model BB501) is an inclined infant sleeper. The verdict is Don't buy because products with an incline over 10 degrees have been banned as hazardous since November 12, 2022, making it illegal to sell. It is also subject to a recall (Vevor Baby Swings, CPSC recall #26074).
verdict.seller_message: Hi, thanks for the listing. Since selling it is unlawful, I'll have to pass. Best wishes.

Seller's description
Older crib but sturdy. The front side slides down so it's easy to lift baby out. Mattress not included.
Photo: U.S. CPSC recall notice #10046

verdict.summary: This is a U.S. solid wood crib with a drop-side design. The verdict is don't buy because drop-side cribs are illegal to resell under federal crib standards effective since June 28, 2011, even if the side has been immobilized.
verdict.seller_message: Hi, thanks for listing this crib. I wanted to let you know that drop-side cribs can't be resold under current federal safety standards (16 CFR 1219/1220; CPSIA §104(c); CPSC Reseller's Guide). Even if the side is immobilized, they don't meet the standard. I'll have to pass, but I appreciate you offering it.
verdict.safer_alternative: Look for a fixed-side crib manufactured after June 2011 that meets the current federal crib standard (16 CFR 1219/1220) and includes all original parts and instructions.
